race.comment: Former Kiwi TOUIE LOUIE NZ (4) has been beaten as a hot favourite in his two Australian starts but both had merit, missing by a head first up at Bathurst before finishing 1.4m away at Wagga last time. Draws lower than in both of those outings and should be peaking now. HUNTER STRIDE (7) had been very consistent with a string of placings before breaking through in a last-start win by one metre at this circuit and distance. Draws wider but can continue the good form. DUTTON (8) draws wide but his best results have come at this circuit and distance including a close second last time. MAJOR EASTWOOD (6) has claims off a placing the only time he raced here last month.
